projects.name: rakanki911/DLSS5-Swapper
projects.description: DLSS 5 Swapper is a powerful, easy-to-use tool for installing, managing, and restoring DLSS 5 across games and supported emulators. It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.
projects.description_cn: DLSS 5 Swapper 是一款功能强大、易于使用的工具，用于跨游戏和支持的模拟器安装、管理和恢复 DLSS 5。它具有自动游戏检测、可选驱动器扫描、用于不带原生 DLSS 的兼容游戏的 DLSS5-Feeder、模拟器支持以及与 DirectX 9/10/11/12、Vulkan 和 OpenGL 的兼容性。

projects.name: 2akouwu/reverify
projects.description: Anti-hallucination for AI agents that read binaries. The model proposes, deterministic tools decide: every claim is VERIFIED or REFUTED against the real bytes, with evidence, and grounded facts survive context resets. MCP server + CLI.
projects.description_cn: 读取二进制文件的人工智能代理的反幻觉。该模型提出，确定性工具决定：每个声明都根据真实字节进行验证或驳斥，有证据，并且有根据的事实在上下文重置后仍然存在。 MCP 服务器 + CLI。
